instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up. In a boxing gym in front of a chain-link cage, the woman with braided hair in a black strapless top (R1) stands in the foreground, punching a speed bag with her left hand wrapped in black tape. The man with a braided mohawk and beard in a black t-shirt (R2) stands behind her to the right, holding her right wrist wrapped in black tape to guide her form. Both focus on the training exercise. Bright overhead gym lighting casts soft shadows across the scene, highlighting the neutral tones of the gym.
